label: End of long (L>=8) sequences starting with i or v: last original token / <DEL>
explanation: Extremely sparse feature (82 dev steps, about 75 sequences). Nearly all activations (~96% of mass) occur in sequences whose first original token is i or v, only for L=8 or 9, and only at steps 7-9: the <DEL> step (about 60% of mass, recall_idx 0, so the model is about to output i/v) or the last 1-2 original tokens (often m, b, x, r). It never fires in the copy phase or before step 7, and never for L<=7. The predicate gets about 91% recall and mass recall but under 0.5% precision: the context is necessary but far from sufficient, and the extra condition that picks the rare active cases was not found (prev-token or last-token lists only raise precision to about 1%). Activations are weak and fairly uniform (mean 0.12, max 0.17). No clear magnitude modulator was found.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=i (+2.77), orig2=f (+2.26), orig1=s (+2.25), orig0=v (+2.22), orig1=n (+1.88), next_out=v (+1.83). Lower it: orig7=- (-2.21), next_out=- (-2.03), orig8=- (-1.62), in_first=0 (-1.59).
